text: [LIVING TRACKER — candidates (a)/(c)/(d) still DEFERRED] Product spec: AutoHarness Framework multi-tier routing/escalation/unified-execution/verification-compaction/checkpoint-recovery (source docs\product-specs\autoHarness-framework-specifications.md). Deliberation 011-DL archived. Candidate (b) telemetry-driven auto-escalation SHIPPED 2026-08-02 as 106-F / shipment 110-S (PR #284, merge ce294d3). Remaining NET-NEW candidates: (a) unified CLI/MCP action-observation execution abstraction — DEFERRED (runtime engine, low in-boundary surface); (c) background Verification & Compaction layer — DEFERRED (engram/runtime; P-020 owns post-merge compaction); (d) crash-resumption + context-pruning-on-restore — DEFERRED (external backlogit/engram binaries). 2026-08-03 (Stage, route claude-opus-4.8/anthropic/high): staged the cross-cutting size+complexity-first-class-staging work (feature 107-F / shipment 112-S) and backlogit telemetry evidence mapping (feature 108-F / shipment 113-S, the 082-F backlogit carve-out). These advance the measurability/verification-telemetry facet that lightly touches (c) WITHOUT harvesting (c) itself. Candidates (a)/(c)/(d) each still need operator lead-selection plus their own spike -> impl-plan -> review -> harvest before any shipment; the spec model-pick reconciliation (spec Ship=Terra / escalation=Sonnet5 vs shipped Ship=claude-sonnet-5) and the external-vs-product boundary remain operator decisions. This entry stays ACTIVE as the living tracker.

[DEFERRED carve-out from 2970FA4E; parts (1)+(3) -> 105-F/109-S on 2026-08-01] Remaining follow-ups: (2) DECISION-GATED true self-repair — auto re-claim/repair of a queued-with-active-work shipment — STILL DEFERRED; requires the operator to DELIBERATELY LIFT shipment-reconcile's current report-and-halt / no-auto-repair stance before any auto-mutation is designed; do not plan until lifted. (EXTERNAL) backlogit-internal active->queued transition guard — RESOLVED-UPSTREAM as of 2026-08-03 (Stage, read-only review of backlogit 1.8.0 @ fd8d2c9d): backlogit now structurally forbids the active->queued shipment transition (internal/core/shipment.go isValidShipmentTransition permits only queued->active and active->shipped|abandoned, returning ErrShipmentConflict otherwise), and ClaimShipment is all-or-nothing with rollback to fully-queued on mid-flight failure (061-F shipment state integrity). The upstream guard requested by this follow-up is therefore satisfied/superseded; no autoharness or backlogit work is required (do not mutate C:\Source\GitHub\backlogit). Context: docs/decisions/2026-07-30-ship-claim-integrity-preflight-spike.md; detect-and-report home in shipment-reconcile pre-mode via 105-F. Entry stays ACTIVE solely as the tracker for operator-gated part (2).

[INVESTIGATION DONE 2026-08-04 as spike 001-SP; DAG ADOPTION DEFERRED — living tracker] Original spike: investigate how DAGs could improve harness delivery speed/reliability across Stage, Ship, backlog sequencing, telemetry, policy gates vs the current linear workflow, preserving P-001/P-016. FINDINGS (001-SP): backlogit item_deps + shipment blocks ALREADY form a dependency DAG; the current linear workflow is its single-active topological linearization. Readiness/critical-path VISIBILITY is safe/in-boundary; PARALLEL-safe multi-worktree execution is a permanent NON-GOAL under P-001/P-016. Findings informed feature 109-F (topology gate) whose 'at most one active shipment' invariant mechanically enforces the single-active DAG linearization. DEFERRED FOLLOW-UP (not harvested this turn, needs own impl-plan->review->harvest): Phase 1 read-only DAG readiness/critical-path REPORTING command over backlogit blocks; Phase 2 (operator-gated) deterministic next-eligible resumption helper (still single-active). Entry stays ACTIVE solely as the tracker for this deferred DAG-visibility follow-up.

[EXTERNAL / backlogit-owned; NOT an autoharness defect; NOT a 115-S blocker] 114-S audit-log completeness discrepancy: .backlogit/logs/114-S.jsonl jumps from shipment_status_changed:active directly to archived, omitting the intermediate shipment_status_changed:shipped event that prior closures (093-S, 096-S) record. Final persisted state is CORRECT (archived_status:shipped, independently verified during 114-S safe-close), so this is an append-only audit-log completeness gap in the backlogit Go binary's move/archive event emission, not a correctness defect and not an autoharness code path. Per the 2026-07-02 cascade-guard external-bug precedent: do NOT mutate C:\Source\GitHub\backlogit and do NOT hand-author a synthetic log entry (would corrupt the append-only trail). Disposition: deferred external tracking only; no autoharness fix fabricated. Re-triage only if evidence shows an autoharness caller should assert on that event's presence. Source: docs/closure/114-S-109-F-post-merge-closure.md (audit-log addendum); docs/decisions/2026-08-05-114s-closure-preactivation-fixes-deliberation.md (Decision 4).
